notes.title: Update 4 Sneak Peek – SAVE WIPES
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!

Unfortunately, in order to implement [b]multi-save support[/b], I wasn’t able to find a way to preserve your current save files.[/p][p]That said, I want to be upfront, [b]save wipes may still happen in the future[/b]. If I can avoid them, I absolutely will, but I appreciate your understanding and apologize for any inconvenience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Now… onto the FUN PART! 🎉[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]🗃️ Multi-Save System[/b][/p][p]You’ll finally be able to start [b]new games[/b] without compromising your existing one![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606276/45c1a288270869e28ec5ebb20fb79b3577fcd793.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]🏝️ Reputation System[/b][/p][p]Everything you do, placing buildings, decorations, and unlocking new advancements, will now contribute to your [b]Reputation[/b].
The higher your reputation, the [b]more villagers will visit your island[/b]!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606276/27faf7bddecf446952bba8536944742534856fef.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🌱 Randomized Starting Resources[/b][/p][p]Each new game will have [b]randomly placed resources[/b], making every playthrough a little different.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606276/3b0785a2befe3c061ab3ffcfa6baf173f28f71fe.png"][/img][/p][p][b]⚠️ Smarter Warnings[/b][/p][p]Clicking on building warnings will now [b]automatically open Advancements[/b] and highlight what you need.
This also applies to [b]advancement notifications[/b], clicking them shows what you just unlocked! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606276/26934b1acaf5c7f0a566b0f032919b34c7563234.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]🌽 New Crops, New Decorations, and More![/b][/p][p]Expect fresh content and quality-of-life improvements in Update 4.[/p]

notes.title: Update 3: Rancher & Animal Feeder
notes.content:
[p][b]Update 3[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Merchant Seller will show you the wait time.[/p][p](Developer Note: The wait time may have a visual bug for the first time) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Readjusted starting positions for the Merchant and Recruitment areas.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tweaked the "Remove" text for buildings and decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the intended advancement path could be bypassed.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer buy chickens or animals until their respective buildings are constructed.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly adjusted the Advancement button layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various collision issues related to roads and buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where removing the Merchant Seller wouldn’t remove the Merchant itself.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]Rancher[/b] worker type and Rancher Advancements.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]Animal Feeder[/b] and its corresponding Advancements.[/p][p](Developer Note: You can feed any crops for now, this system will be expanded with more updates.) [/p][/*][*][p]Moved Fence and Gate to the [b]Decorations[/b] tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Animal Tile[/b] to the Crafting menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed [b]Farm[/b] to [b]Farm Tile[/b], [b]Grass[/b] to [b]Grass Tile[/b], and [b]Sand[/b] to [b]Sand Tile[/b] in Crafting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a highlight flash effect when clicking on warnings above buildings to indicate what needs to be unlocked via Advancements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where roads could be placed on top of farm tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished all tooltips in the Advancements menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Readjusted prices for animal drops and unique crops.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Icons next to the building names in Menus.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Developer Note:[/i]
Some items in your inventory were not the correct type, so they had to be removed.
You may notice that some crops, resources or workers are missing.
If items still have old prices, sell old items before you try to get new ones.
The Worker NPCs will always need polishing, and I will continue to improve it![/p][p]
More Updates will follow![/p]

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content: [p][b]Update 2[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Explorer Upgrades to the Advancements menu![/p][/*][*][p]Added Gatherer Upgrades to the Advancements menu![/p][/*][*][p]Added a Decoration tab to the Crafting menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 7 new decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning message in Advancements for actions that workers currently cannot perform.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the Recruitment System to now bring in 2 random Recruits.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AI behavior for Gatherers.[/p][/*][*][p]Readjusted prices for hiring Recruits. You can now hire twice at the same price early on, helping automate your farm faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a display issue with currency order in tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the error message when attempting to plant crops in an invalid location.[/p][/*][*][p]Market Advancement now unlocks upon gathering a resource, not just when unlocking Bridge Advancement.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]More updates will follow![/p]

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content: [p][b]Update 1.a[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added an Error Message against corrupted save files.[/p][/*][*][p]No need to worry the save files are still present, just contact @mrdboy_ on [url="https://discord.gg/434NG4wR5q"]discord[/url]![/p][/*][*][p]Or use the Steam Forums to contact @mrdboy![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Update 1[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed Parsley to Parsnip.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Pick-Up amount for Gatherers from 5 to a range of 4 to 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the way you add or remove items from Market.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer sell your unique blueprints.[/p][/*][*][p]Added camera smoothing in the Accessibility settings – allows the camera to either stay fixed or follow the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Resource Icon to the Explorer Recruitment description.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "! Warning" above a Carrier’s head when they can’t reach the Warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "! Warning" above a Farmer’s head when they can’t reach their home.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the time it takes for a worker to arrive at the Recruitment Tent from 7 days to 5 days.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Farmers could water crops that were not properly connected to farmland or roads.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an edge case where a Farmer wouldn’t select a new crop to plant if their current target was unreachable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the tooltip for a missing bridge connection wouldn’t show when hovering over the bridge.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Carriers wouldn’t deliver items if roads were not fully connected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an edge case where Gatherers would get stuck trying to gather a crop they couldn’t reach.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: MR FARMBOY DEMO UPDATE 3
notes.content:
[b]Update 3[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Feedback Window in Settings, you can send Feedback straight from the game!
[*] Allow building bridges closer to the Merchant.
[*] Removing crops will refund the cost!
[*] Able to click on buildings from all sides, not just the front.
[*] Added Shift + F to show/hide UI.
[*] Visual Polish on Workers, different sprites!
[*] Main Menu Tweaks and Updates(Zoom, Game Version, Updates, Credits).
[*] Added Green House, Parsley can only be planted in it.
[*] Pigs drop animal Manure instead of Hay!
[*] Animal Item drops are now Magnetized as well!
[*] Reworked all building icons that are displayed in Crafting/Advancements.
[*] 
[/list]
UI Tweaks
Minor Bug Fixes and Tweaks

notes.title: MR FARMBOY DEMO UPDATE 2
